Definition: from G2087 and G1320; to instruct differently:--teach other doctrine(-wise).
BiblicalUsage: heterodidaskaléō means teach other doctrine. It turns up twice, in 1 Timothy.
TheologicalSignificance: I take heterodidaskaléō as it stands — teach other doctrine — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
